fato_historico: 1933: Yevgeniy Abalakov is the first man to reach the highest point in the Soviet Union, Communism Peak (now called Ismoil Somoni Peak and situated in Tajikistan) (7495 m).
energia_do_dia: The stars align to suggest that your persistence is your greatest asset. Just as an explorer once conquered the highest icy peaks to see the world from above, you may find yourself reaching a new vantage point in your personal life. Consider this a day to elevate your perspective and embrace the steady, grounded growth that defines your beautiful earthy nature.
frase_do_dia: Even the highest mountains are climbed one steady step at a time.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of your most ambitious and grounded dreams.
conselho: Trust your steady pace and enjoy the view from your new height.
